claim: On September 26th, 2023 the Firehose guide added Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka as a data source, so you can configure Amazon MSK to send information to a Firehose stream.
question: Since when can Amazon MSK be a source of a Firehose stream?
note: Older exam questions list only Direct PUT, Kinesis Data Streams and AWS service sources for Firehose.
